def chain_of_tokens(tokens):
    tokens = sorted(tokens)
    result = []
    for i in range(len(tokens) - 1):
        result.append(tokens[i])
        result.append(tokens[i + 1])
    result.append(tokens[-1])
    return ','.join(result)
